name: BroadcastChannel
plain: Lets tabs and frames of the same site send messages to each other instantly.
meaning: A site can see that the same person has several tabs open and sync a login, logout or shopping state. Since partitioning, a tracker embed can no longer message its own copy on a different top site.

access.persistence: While at least one context is open
access.revocation: Clear site data, browser privacy settings

limits.headline: Can send messages between open tabs and frames of the same site
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens while you have the same site open in more than one tab.
can: Pass messages instantly between open tabs of the same site
Do things like log out of all tabs or sync a cart
Send text or small bits of data
cannot: Send messages to other apps on your device
limits.reach_label: Only tabs of the same site

story.what_it_is: Lets tabs and frames of the same site send each other messages instantly.

marketing.name: Broadcast Channel API
marketing.pitch: Documents how pages of the same site can send messages to each other across tabs.

story.for_you: You never see it. It is why you log out in one tab and every other tab of that site logs out too, or why a cart count updates everywhere.
story.for_makers: It keeps many open tabs in sync with no server round trip. Makers use it for logins, settings and shared state. It only works between pages of the same site.

use_cases.example: You sign out on one tab of a web app and every other open tab of that app locks too.
You add an item to your cart in one tab and the count updates in all your other tabs.
A browser game warns you if you open it in a second tab, so two copies do not fight over the same save.
A web chat marks messages read in every tab as soon as you read them in one.
A document editor tells other tabs that you changed a setting, such as dark mode.
A web player pauses in one tab when you start another video in a second tab.
A tracker script on one tab tells a script on another tab of the same site about your visit.

risks: Cross tab tracking inside one site

technical_bounds: Same origin and same storage partition only
